sigma_analysis_results.rule_title: Suspicious Msbuild Execution By Uncommon Parent Process
sigma_analysis_results.rule_description: Detects suspicious execution of 'Msbuild.exe' by a uncommon parent process

mitre_attack_techniques.signature_description: The PE file contains a PDB path
The PE file contains an overlay
Guard pages use detected - possible anti-debugging.
The process attempted to dynamically load a malicious function
The binary has an Authenticode signature
The file have a Trusted Certificate
The process tried to load dynamically one or more functions.
The process has tried to detect the debugger probing the use of page guards.
The process attempted to detect a running debugger using common APIs
.NET source code contains functionality to register a task
Creates guard pages, often used to prevent reverse engineering and debugging
May sleep (evasive loops) to hinder dynamic analysis
Allocates memory with a write watch (potentially for evading sandboxes)
Queries the volume information (name, serial number etc) of a device
